Subject: Partner paper: billing/pass-through on Marketplace MSA

Hi Ben,

We're preparing the procurement packet for the Acme Marketplace listing and have a couple of items that need Redwood's confirmation for the MSA and the Order Form:

- Procurement requires explicit language that marketplace invoices (issued by Acme) can be accepted as the primary billing instrument and that Redwood will permit pass-through of marketplace processing fees and taxes to the end customer.
- They also want evidence of invoice mappings from SKU -> Redwood product names and a short note on auditability (e.g., logs or sample invoices).

I've attached the marketplace terms we send to partners. Can your legal/finance team:
  1) confirm which pass-throughs Redwood can accept (taxes, marketplace fees, refunds/chargebacks, penalties),
  2) propose any carveouts we should expect in the MSA or Order Form, and
  3) give a target turnaround so we can close by next Tue (Jul 6) for procurement review.

Attachment: Acme_Marketplace_Terms.pdf (pdf)

Thanks — appreciate the help.

Sanjay

Subject: RE: Partner paper: billing/pass-through on Marketplace MSA

Hi Sanjay / Ben,

Thanks for the context — reviewed the attached terms. High-level legal position and proposed approach below.

1) What we can accept 
- Pass-through of taxes (sales/use/VAT) charged by Acme to the end customer: acceptable; Redwood will not duplicate tax collection.
- Marketplace processing fees (payment gateway fees billed by Acme): generally acceptable to pass through if they are disclosed and tied to a line-item on the invoice.

2) Carveouts we need in MSA/Order Form 
- Indemnity and penalty language: Redwood cannot accept pass-through of refund penalties or fines that arise from Redwood's breach or negligence. We propose a limited carveout: Acme may pass through fees and taxes, but not penalties tied to Redwood's conduct.
- Audit and data access: Redwood can provide SKU -> product mapping and limited audit logs. We will not provide full raw payment processor logs; instead we will provide summarized mapping and evidence sufficient for procurement.

3) Draft language (high level)
- Insert a "Marketplace Billing Appendix" into the Order Form that:
  a) confirms invoices issued by Acme are the primary billing instrument;
  b) details which fees/taxes are eligible for pass-through;
  c) includes a sample invoice attachment or invoice mapping table.

I've attached a redline of the MSA with proposed bracketed edits and an Order Form appendix template: Redline_MSA_Acme.pdf (redline PDF).

Please review and tell us which specific pass-through items are non-negotiable on your procurement side.

Laura Bennett
Associate General Counsel
Redwood Inference
Attachment: Redline_MSA_Acme.pdf (pdf)

- For the auditability ask: can you provide (a) a sample mapping table that ties Acme invoice line items to Redwood SKUs, and (b) a short explanation of what logs we can provide and how frequently?

I've attached a sample invoice and the procurement questionnaire so you can see the level of detail they expect.
